gen-gf-abyssinica-sil-general-sans: General Sans draws every letter with one steady nib, smooth around each bend. General Sans sits beside Abyssinica SIL, whose short ascenders, big bowls and gentle contrast give the serif a dignified feel.
gen-gf-amiri-quran-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and bookish, Amiri Quran leads with gently shaded strokes. It excels at dense, knitted strands of touching letters, while Bespoke Sans is best at sharp, refined shapes with generous space where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-arbutus-general-sans: Arbutus spreads its big-countered letters far apart, with a friendly, mild contrast in each stroke. And General Sans, a sans-serif with steady pressure and a full-height lowercase, lets text flow smoothly line after line.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-paquito: Autour One is bold and expressive, with clear channels leading into each round letter. Then Paquito, a confident serif with caps sitting close to the lowercase, brings an approachable tone that softens the display punch.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Loud, round and expressive, Autour One never swells on a downstroke. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a contemporary sans-serif with big open lowercase eyes, sits underneath and keeps text approachable and easy to follow.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-montserrat-alternat: Autour One hits hard, all round shapes and no hairline shifts. What ties them is a uniform line: Montserrat Alternates matches its round rims to its stems, and its lowercase crowds up toward cap height.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-cardo: Baumans has a c like a crescent wrench and strokes like drawn wire. Cardo supplies the literary counterweight, its fuller stems and slimmer links making a soft cadence under all that uniform wire.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-graduate: Graduate is dignified and bookish, with generous space between its letters. Baumans does its best work with a commanding, constant-width line, while Graduate excels at serif text with stems and joins that never contrast.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-spectral-sc: Baumans is pure wire: one outline you can trace with a finger. Spectral SC adds literary, bookish texture, with sturdy hairlines, moderate stems and wide-mouthed round forms that give the heading's uniform line something to push against.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-karma: Bellota bends thin steel rod into letters, its s ends hanging far from the spine. But Karma, a serif, does the trustworthy text work, with modulation that never snags the eye.
